title: Algorithms
summary: Think about speed and memory, and learn the classic ways to search, sort and solve problems.
outcomes: Estimate how the work of an algorithm grows (Big-O)
Implement and compare basic sorting algorithms
Solve problems with recursion, memoisation and dynamic programming
Use stacks, queues, heaps, trees and graphs

lessons.summary: How to tell a fast algorithm from a slow one.

lessons.title: Searching and sorting

lessons.title: Recursion, memoisation and dynamic programming
lessons.summary: Solve big problems by solving small ones once.

lessons.title: Stacks, queues, trees and graphs
lessons.summary: The structures behind most real programs.

gameSummary: Beat the gauntlet with correct and fast algorithms. Slow solutions run out of time.
